get.summary:
Looks up the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records of the domain an account sends from and says,
per record, whether it is `ok`, `missing`, `weak`, or `unknown` (the lookup failed, or no
DKIM selector was given), with a fixed `code` the clients translate: `spf_ok`,
`spf_missing`, `spf_weak`, `spf_unknown`, `dkim_ok`, `dkim_missing`, `dkim_unknown`,
`dmarc_ok`, `dmarc_missing`, `dmarc_weak`, `dmarc_unknown`. Nothing is sent. Owner only,
limited by the same bucket as the test email.
get.description:
# Errors

409 `capability_unsupported` for an account that cannot check a sending domain, or
`platform_disabled`; 422 `validation_failed` (`field` is `dkim_selector`) for a selector
that is not one DNS label; 404 for a missing account.

parameters.name: dkim_selector
parameters.description:
The DKIM selector to check, one DNS label such as `s1` or `google` (letters, digits,
and inner hyphens, at most 63); the sending service names it. Without one, DKIM is
`unknown`.

post.summary:
Sends `email` once to the signed-in user's own verified address through a direct-send
account, such as an email sending method. A test send writes no delivery row, counts
against no daily cap, tracks nothing, and carries no unsubscribe headers; its footer link
shows a "this was a test" page. Owner only. Unsaved drafts are fine: the document is the
body, not a post.
post.description:
# Errors

409 `live_publish_disabled` while live publishing is off, `platform_disabled`,
`capability_unsupported` for an account that cannot send to people,
`email_address_missing` when the user has no verified address, and `test_send_refused`
when the mail server did not take the mail for the address, refusing it or failing for
now (the agent's reason code in `detail`); 422
`validation_failed` with every rule the document breaks; 404 for a missing account or
image. A failed send answers with the mapped agent error, its code in `detail`.

repair when the model's answer is not usable. Nothing is published and no post is created:

get.summary:
Finds the one active user with this verified email, to grant them a delegation. Any
active user may call it. The answer is the same `{ "user": null }` for no match, several
matches, an unverified or inactive user, and the caller themselves. Every call is charged
to the caller's lookup rate limit. Does not accept `X-Postit-Act-As` (`owner_only`).

lookup limit is spent.

available.description:

guide_url.description: Where the user gets a key.

local.description: A server on the user's own machine.

AiProviderDto.description: A provider in the view the caller may see: `owner` or `delegate`.

oneOf.description: Why not.

details.description: Event details. Every `*_user_id` value is a `UserRef` object.

ip.description: Client IP, until it is cleared by retention.

oneOf.description: Owner of the workspace the action touched.

request_id.description: `X-Request-Id` of the request that caused the event.

oneOf.description: Who the action was about.

client's kind filter is typed from. Clients must tolerate values added later.

AuthConfigDto.description: What a client needs to start the OIDC sign-in.

android_client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the Android app, or null when the deployment has none.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the web client.

ios_client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the iOS app, or null when the deployment has none.

issuer.description: Issuer URL of the identity provider.

avoid_words.description: Words the drafter must not use.

default_language.description: The language to write in by default.

examples.description: Posts that sound right, at most five.

id.description: The profile, or `null` while none was written.

updated_at.description: When it last changed, or `null` while none was written.

items.description: Live jobs due in the range, soonest first.

CalendarItemDto.description: One scheduled job on the calendar.

account_ids.description: The accounts it goes to that the caller can see.

text_head.description: The first line of the post's text, cut to 80 graphemes.

CalendarKindDto.description:

ignore kinds they do not know.

archived.description: Whether it is hidden from the default list.

color.description: A display color, as the client chose it.

CancelReportDto.description: What a cancel did to each delivery that had not ended.

not_cancellable.description:
Left as they were: an unknown outcome (resolve it instead), a platform still
processing, or a native upload the agent could not delete.

requested.description: Running: the worker stops at its next safe checkpoint.

ChangeDelegationRequest.description: Changes to a live delegation. Absent fields stay as they are.

account_ids.description: A new account limit, replacing the old one; an empty list means posts and media only.

all_accounts.description:
`true` lifts the account limit. `false` is refused: send `account_ids` instead.
Cannot be sent together with `account_ids`.

expires_at.description:
A new expiry in the future, or `null` to clear it. Absent leaves it unchanged, so a
client that always serializes nulls must send the current value to keep it.

oneOf.description: A new level.

ColumnMap.description:
Which CSV header holds each contact field. Header names are matched after trimming and
after undoing the export's formula escape: one leading `'` before `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab,
or CR is ignored in the file's headers and in these names alike, so `'=x` and `=x` name the
same column, and a file holding both is refused as ambiguous.

consent_at.description: When consent was given: RFC 3339, or a `YYYY-MM-DD` date taken as midnight UTC.

consent_source.description: The column noting where consent came from. Required.

fields.description: Custom merge fields: CSV header to field name.

tags.description: Tags, separated by `|` in a cell.

account.description: The account the comments are on.

account_ids.description: The `remote_id` of each account to connect; omit to connect every discovered account.

ConfirmResponse.description: The result of confirming a connection.

skipped_elsewhere.description: How many chosen accounts someone else already has connected.

unknown.description: Chosen IDs the credential did not reach.

ConnectMethod.description: How to connect: `oauth`, or `credentials` with the schema of fields to collect.

schema.description: A JSON Schema document in the postit options subset (free-form object).

ConnectedAccountDto.description: One connected account and what happened to it.

consent_source.description: Where the contact's consent came from.

status.description: Whether the contact may be emailed.

attested_at.description: When the owner attested consent for the addresses.

list_id.description: The list the import adds its contacts to, until that list is deleted.

rows_ok.description: How many rows became or updated contacts so far.

rows_rejected.description: How many rows were rejected so far.

rows_total.description: How many data rows the file had.

ContactImportForm.description: The parts of `POST /contacts/import`, in this order.

file.description: The CSV file: UTF-8, comma or semicolon separated, with a header row.

options.description: The import options, as JSON. Must come first.

ContactImportRejectionDto.description: A row an import did not turn into a contact.

row.description: The row's position in the file; the header is row 1.

members.description: How many contacts are in it.

ContactListRequest.description: A list's name, to create or rename it.

ContactStatusDto.description: Whether a contact may be emailed.

Adds a provider: from a preset (`preset`, plus `api_key` unless the preset is local, and an
optional `default_model`), or from a pasted opencode configuration (`opencode`). Exactly one
of `preset` and `opencode`.

api_key.description: The API key. Write-only: never returned.

default_model.description: The model used when a request names none.

A pasted opencode `provider` entry, optionally wrapped as `{ "provider": { "<id>":
{...} } }`. Its `options.apiKey` and `options.headers` values are stored sealed and never
returned; `{env:...}` and `{file:...}` values are refused.

ends_on.description: The last day it runs; not before `starts_on` (`validation_failed`, `field: "ends_on"`).

CreateContactRequest.description:
A contact to add. An address already in the book updates that contact instead: fields
given here replace the old values, custom `fields` merge key by key, and the rest stays.

consent_at.description: When consent was given; defaults to now.

consent_source.description: Where the contact's consent came from ("signup form", "customer", "event"). Required.

CreatePostRequest.description: A post to create (or to validate without saving).

disclose_ai_generated.description: Whether the post says it was made with AI.

generation_id.description: The AI generation this post was saved from; it links to the post.

kind.description: Whether it starts a conversation or answers one (default `post`).

link.description: The link to attach, an absolute URL.

media.description: The attachments, in order (the position field is ignored).

oneOf.description: What a comment answers; required for a comment.

CredentialCheckResponse.description: The result of checking a pasted credential.

connect_id.description: Confirm with this ID. Shown once; absent when the credential reaches no account.

DelegationDto.description: A delegation: the owner lets the delegate act in the owner's workspace.

account_ids.description:
The accounts the delegate reaches when `all_accounts` is false (possibly none: posts
and media only). Empty when `all_accounts` is true.

all_accounts.description: Whether the delegate reaches every account; when false, only `account_ids`.

ended_at.description: When it ended; null while live.

oneOf.description: Why it ended; null while live.

expires_at.description: When it stops working; null for never.

owner.description: The user whose workspace it opens.

DelegationUserDto.description: One side of a delegation: a user by ID, current name, and status.

status.description: The user's account status. A grant only works while both users are `active`.

DeleteMeRequest.description: Confirmation for deleting one's own account.

display_name.description: Must equal the caller's current display name.

DeliveryDto.description: One post going to one account.

created_by.description: Who created the job it belongs to (a user ID).

oneOf.description: Progress of a direct send.
The classified error behind the last failure or park.

operation.description: What it does on the platform.

oneOf.description: Why it is parked, while `state` is `parked`.

remote_id.description: The platform's ID for the post.

remote_publish_at.description: When a natively scheduled post goes live.

oneOf.description: Why it is parked, for parked and stale notices.

audience.description: Recipients the delivery was materialized for.

bounced.description: Recipients whose address bounced after the provider accepted it.

native_scheduled_remaining.description: Deliveries still held for a later time on the platform's side.

handle.description: The `@handle`, when the platform has one.

remote_id.description: The platform's ID for the account. Pass it to confirm to pick this account.

translate; no domain, selector, or record text is returned.

DomainRecord.description: Which sender-domain DNS record a finding is about.

EmailBlock.description: One block of an email body.

decide the direction or the footer.

preheader.description: Preview text shown next to the subject in most inboxes.

EmailImageBlock.description: An image from the media library.

alt.description: Text for readers who cannot see the image.

link.description: Where the image links to, if anywhere.

EmailLanguage.description:
The language an email campaign is written in. It sets the body's direction, the footer's
language, and the language of the unsubscribe page, whatever each contact's own locale.

EmojiUseDto.description: How much emoji a draft uses.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable problem code (the `code` member of every problem+json body).

FitFix.description: Crop or pad the media to this aspect ratio.

FormatSelector.description: Picks a format explicitly: the format applies when the target's option equals the value.

option.description: Name of the option in the agent's options schema.

value.description: The option value that selects this format.

FormatSpec.description: One format an agent can publish.

oneOf.description: Option that selects this format over content-based inference.

GenerateRequestDto.description: A generation request. Nothing is published and no post is created.

comment_id.description: The inbox item to answer, in reply mode.

language.description:
The language to write in, as a BCP 47 tag; else the account's writing style, the brand
profile, the comment's language, then the caller's interface language.

link.description: The link the post carries. The drafter never writes a link of its own.

media_ids.description:
Media the post carries, at most 10, in order; the model sees up to 4 images and 4

model.description: The model; the provider's default when absent.

prompt.description:
What to write about (at most 8,000 characters), or the text to rewrite. May be empty in
reply mode.

provider_id.description: The provider; the owner's default when absent.

targets.description: The accounts to write for, 1 to 20; exactly one, the comment's account, in reply mode.

GenerationDto.description: A generation's result. The draft is not saved: the user reviews it and saves it as a post.

notes.description: Notes for the user, such as `ai.media_ignored`.

oneOf.description: Tokens spent, when the provider reported them.

violations.description: What is still wrong, by account ID; accounts with nothing wrong are left out.

GrantDelegationRequest.description: A new delegation in the caller's workspace.

account_ids.description:
Limit the grant to these of the caller's connected accounts; an empty list means posts
and media only. Absent means every account.

delegate_id.description: The user to let in: an `active` user other than the caller (see `/users/lookup`).

expires_at.description: When it stops working, in the future; absent or null for never.

HashtagUseDto.description: How many hashtags a draft carries.

ImportOptions.description: What an import is told before the file is read.

attest_consent.description: The owner attests they have consent to email these addresses. Must be `true`.

oneOf.description: The list the import adds its contacts to.

ImportReportDto.description: The result of an import, in file order.

commit.description: Whether accounts were connected (`true`) or the file was only checked.

counts.description: How many rows ended each way, keyed by status.

truncated.description: The file has more rows than the server's row limit; the rest were not read.

ImportRowDto.description: The report line for one data row. Never carries a field value.

account_ids.description: The accounts created or matched; empty on a dry run.

display_name_ignored.description: A `display_name` was given but the row reaches more than one account.

field.description: The credential field at fault, when known.

violations.description: The violation codes, for `invalid_fields`.

JobActionResponse.description: The job a retry or trigger created.

JobActionsDto.description: The console actions the job currently offers.

cancel.description: Cancel the job before it runs.

delete.description: Delete the job and its history.

retry.description: Re-run the job as a new job.

JobCountDto.description: A count under a key (state, type or queue).

key.description: The state, type or queue name.

JobDetailDto.description: A job with its attempt history and retry links.

retried_by.description: The job created to retry this one.

retried_from.description: The job this one is a manual retry of.

oneOf.description: Why no action applies, when none does.

finished_at.description: When the job reached a final state.

recurring_name.description: Name of the recurring schedule that enqueued it.

run_at.description: When the job is (or was) due.

started_at.description: When the current or last attempt started.

JobStateDto.description: Where a job is in its life. Clients must tolerate values added later.

window_hours.description: Length of the throughput window in hours.

JobStatus.description: The status of a publish job, derived from its deliveries.

KindSwitchDto.description: How one kind of notification reaches the caller.

email.description: Whether this kind is emailed; null for kinds that are never emailed.

push.description: Whether this kind is pushed to the caller's devices.

email.description:
Email on or off; null or absent leaves the stored choice. Rejected with
`validation_failed` for kinds that are never emailed.

push.description: Push on or off; null or absent leaves the stored choice.

LastErrorDto.description: The classified error behind a failed or parked delivery.

class.description: How the engine treated it, such as `retryable`.

LastPublishedDto.description: The version and time of the newest live delivery to an account.

post_version.description: The post version that went out.

LevelDto.description: What a delegate may do in the owner's workspace.

LocaleDto.description: A language the interface and emails can be shown in.

LookupResponse.description: The result of a user lookup.

oneOf.description: The one matching user, or null.

MarkReadRequest.description:
Which notifications to mark read: exactly one of `ids` (1 to 200 of the caller's own;
others are ignored) or `all: true`.

all.description: Every unread notification of the caller. Only `true` selects anything.

account_url.description: The identity provider's account page (`auth.oidc.account_url`), when configured.

MediaAssetId.description: Identifier of a stored media asset.

derived_from.description: The asset this one was fitted from.

mime.description: The MIME type the bytes sniffed as; unset until the upload completes.

original_filename.description: The name the uploaded file had. Metadata only; it never reaches a path.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes, once known.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

MediaItem.description: One media asset attached to a post.

alt_text.description: Description for readers who cannot see the media.

MediaRules.description: Limits on the media of a format.

aspect_ratios.description: Allowed aspect ratios; empty allows any.

mime_types.description: Allowed MIME types; empty allows any of the kinds.

MediaStatusDto.description: Where a media asset is in its upload and processing life.

quota_bytes.description: The quota in bytes; 0 means unlimited.

used_bytes.description: Bytes stored or reserved by open uploads.

Message.description: A message key and its English text. Clients translate known keys and fall back to `en`.

en.description: English default shown when no translation exists.

key.description: Stable key, namespaced by platform ID for agent text (e.g. `tiktok.privacy.label`).

NativeScheduleWindow.description: How far ahead a platform accepts a natively scheduled post.

NotificationDto.description:

recorded with the notification, so an old row reads the same after a rename or a revoked
grant. Clients must tolerate kinds added later.

owner_id.description:
The workspace owner the notice is about; absent for deployment notices. A delegate
uses it to tell the workspaces they act in apart.

oneOf.description:
`delivery_dead_lettered`, `delivery_failed`, `delivery_outcome_unknown`,
`delivery_parked`, `delivery_stale`, `delivery_published`.
`job_partial`.
`reconnect_by_passed`, `reconnect_reminder`.
`recurrence_skipped`.
`new_comments`.
`delegation_changed`.
`user_pending`.
`account_needs_reconnect`, `account_revoked_by_platform`.

The payload of a notification: the object `kind` names (`delivery_*` and
`delivery_published` carry a delivery payload, `job_partial` a job payload, and so on).
Serialized as the bare object. Order matters to generated clients that try each shape in
turn: shapes that are a subset of another come last.
The details of what happened; its shape depends on `kind`.

authorize_url.description: Send the user's browser here to sign in to the platform. It carries a one-time `state`.

expires_at.description: When the sign-in must be finished by.

ParkReason.description: Why a delivery is waiting for something outside the engine.

PatchCampaignRequest.description: Changes to a campaign. Absent fields stay as they are; `null` clears a date or the color.

color.description: A new display color, or `null` to clear it.

ends_on.description: A new last day, or `null` to clear it.

starts_on.description: A new first day, or `null` to clear it.

PatchPostRequest.description:
Changes to a post. Absent fields stay as they are; `null` clears the reply target, the
campaign, or the link. The kind never changes.

campaign_id.description: The campaign, or `null` to remove the post from it.

disclose_ai_generated.description: Whether the post says it was made with AI.

link.description: The link, or `null` to remove it.

media.description: The attachments, replacing the earlier ones.

oneOf.description: What a comment answers, or `null` to clear it.

targets.description:
The targets, replacing the ones the caller can see; targets outside a limited
delegate's account limit stay.

oneOf.description: The new role.

PendingConnectionDto.description:
A connection waiting for the user to pick accounts, from pasted credentials or an OAuth
sign-in.

connect.description: How the accounts would be connected.

discovered.description: The accounts it reaches; confirm with the `remote_id`s to connect.

expires_at.description: When the connection can no longer be confirmed.

Post.description: The content shared by every target of a publish.

disclose_ai_generated.description: Whether the post says it was made with AI.

oneOf.description: What a comment answers; required for [`PostKind::Comment`].

last_published.description:
The newest live delivery per account, so a client can warn that a version was already
published there.

PostDto.description:
A post with everything the caller can see of it. A delegate with a limited account list
sees only the targets, overrides, and last published entries inside the limit.

PostKind.description: Whether a post starts a conversation or answers one.

position.description: Its place among the attachments, counting from 0.

PostOverride.description: Changes one account makes to the shared post. Absent fields keep the post's value.

oneOf.description: The email document, for an email account.

link.description: Replacement link: absent keeps the post's link, `null` removes it.

media.description: A subset of the post's media, in the order to publish it.

options.description: Values for the agent's options schema.

PostOverrideDto.description: A per-account override of a post.

patch.description: The fields that differ from the post.

PostStatusDto.description: Where a post is in its publishing life.

PostSummaryDto.description: A post without its media, targets, or overrides: an item of the post list.

disclose_ai_generated.description: Whether the post says it was made with AI.

kind.description: Whether it starts a conversation or answers one.

oneOf.description: What a comment answers.

status.description: Where it is in its publishing life.

version.description: Counts content changes, starting at 1; the `ETag` is `"v{version}"`.

comment_digest.description: Whether comment notifications are emailed as a daily digest.

email_notifications.description: The master switch for emails about activity.

locale.description: The language of the interface and of emails sent to the caller.

store_ai_prompts.description:
Whether the caller's AI prompts are kept with their generations, so the generation
history shows them (for 30 days by default). Off unless the caller turns it on; a
delegate's generations follow the owner's choice.

switches.description: One entry per notification kind, critical kinds first.

timezone.description:
IANA time zone name (for example `Asia/Riyadh`); times are shown and digests are
scheduled in it.

ProblemDetails.description: The RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body every error response carries.

field.description:
`credentials_invalid`: the credential field at fault, when known. `push_endpoint_invalid`:
`endpoint`, `p256dh`, or `auth`.

missing_scopes.description: `credentials_invalid`: scopes the credentials lack, when the platform says.

request_id.description: The `X-Request-Id` of the failed request, for support.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

violations.description: `validation_failed` on account routes: every rule the input broke, by field.

deliveries.description: Its deliveries inside the caller's account limit.

PublishJobDto.description: A publish job with the deliveries the caller can see.

PublishJobId.description: Identifier of a publish job (one post sent to several targets).

PublishJobSummaryDto.description: A publish job without its deliveries: an item of the job list.

native_schedule.description: Whether platforms hold the post until its time.

status.description: Where it is, derived from its deliveries.

version.description: Bumped on every delivery change; the `ETag` is `"v{version}"`.

PublishRequest.description: What to publish a saved post as. Needs `If-Match` with the post's `ETag`.

oneOf.description: When to publish; now when absent.

confirm.description: The caller's confirmation of a live publish.

native_schedule.description: Whether platforms that can hold the post until `at` do so.

targets.description: The accounts to publish to; a client expands target groups itself.

live.description: Whether live publishing is on. While off, live deliveries park and dry runs still run.

native_scheduled_count.description: Uploads that platforms hold for a later publish time: the switch cannot stop them.

PushPlatformDto.description: Which push service reaches the device.

PutBrandProfileRequest.description: The brand profile to store; it replaces the earlier one. Absent fields are empty.

avoid_words.description: Words the drafter must not use.

default_language.description: The language to write in by default.

examples.description: Posts that sound right, at most five (`validation_failed` with `field: "examples"`).

options.description:
Platform options for this account, checked against the agent's schema when publishing
or validating.

patch.description:
The fields that differ from the post: text, link, tags, a subset of its media, the
email document for an email target.

PutUserLimitsRequest.description: New limits for a user. `0` means unlimited; a negative number is `validation_failed`.

contacts_cap.description: Contacts the user may keep; `0` is unlimited.

email_daily_cap.description: Emails the user may send per day; `0` is unlimited.

storage_quota_bytes.description: Bytes of media the user may store; `0` is unlimited.

PutWritingStyleRequest.description: The writing style to store; it replaces the earlier one. Absent fields are empty.

language.description: The language to write in, when it differs from the brand's default.

notes.description: Anything else the drafter should know.

tone.description: The tone, in the owner's words.

QuotaBucket.description: A calendar-aligned quota the platform enforces.

default_limit.description: Allowance per period when the deployment sets no override.

id.description: Bucket name, unique within the agent.

reset_time_zone.description: IANA time zone the period is aligned to. Stored, not resolved, here.

scope.description: What the bucket is shared by.

QuotaCosts.description: What each operation costs against a bucket. 0 means the operation does not count.

QuotaPeriod.description: How often a quota bucket resets.

QuotaScope.description: What a quota bucket is shared by.

ReconnectNotice.description: Payload of the reconnect-by kinds; one per account.

reconnect_by.description: The date the platform stops honoring the connection.

oneOf.description: The reminder stage; `None` once the date has passed.

RecurringJobDto.description: A recurring job and its schedule.

last_run_at.description: When the newest run was scheduled.

next_run_at.description: When the next run is due.

RegisterPushEndpointRequest.description:
A device to receive push notifications, from the browser's or app's push subscription.
Registering an endpoint again replaces its keys, platform, and label and keeps its ID.

device_label.description: A name for the device, shown in the profile; at most 100 characters.

endpoint.description:
The push service URL: `https`, or `http` only when the deployment allows private
endpoints (a self-hosted `UnifiedPush` distributor on a LAN). At most 2048 characters.

p256dh.description: The subscription's public key: a 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point, base64url.

ReminderStage.description: How near the reconnect-by date a reminder is.

RemoveMediaFix.description: Remove the media item at `index`, or all media when it is absent.

index.description: Zero-based position; absent for every item.

ReplyTo.description: What a comment answers, in the platform's own terms.

remote_comment_id.description: The platform's ID of the comment being answered, when replying to a comment.

remote_post_id.description: The platform's ID of the post being answered.

url.description: A link to what is being answered.

failed.description: Natively scheduled uploads the platform did not move; they keep their old time.

moved.description: Deliveries now at the new time.

RescheduleRequest.description: A new time for a job that has not started. Needs `If-Match` with the job's `ETag`.

ResolveRequest.description: Settling a delivery whose outcome nobody can verify.

outcome.description: Whether the post is live (`published`) or not and will not be retried (`failed`).

ResolvedOutcome.description: How a user settles a delivery whose outcome nobody can verify.

RetryRequest.description: Sending a failed or stuck delivery again.

acknowledge_outcome_unknown.description:
For a delivery whose outcome is unknown: the caller accepts that the post may already
be live.

SafeZone.description: A part of the frame the platform's interface covers. Fractions of the frame, 0 to 1.

label.description: What the zone is for, e.g. "keep captions inside".

oneOf.description: An exact instant.
A wall-clock time in a zone.

zone.description: IANA zone name such as `Europe/Berlin`; the caller's own zone when absent.

When a post goes out, as a client sends it.

A string is RFC 3339 *with* an offset (`2026-11-08T09:00:00+02:00`); a string without an
offset does not parse. An object is a local date-time (seconds optional) and an optional

SetLivePublishingRequest.description: Turning live publishing on or off.

SetPlatformEnabledRequest.description: Switching a platform on or off.

enabled.description: Whether the platform is switched on.

ShortenTextFix.description: Shorten the text to at most this many units of the format's measure.

SkipReason.description: Why a recurrence skipped an occurrence.

StartOAuthRequest.description: Where the browser goes back to once the platform's sign-in is over.

return_to.description:
Exactly one of the deployment's allowed return URLs: the web app's `/oauth-done`, the
mobile app's `<scheme>://oauth-done`, or a configured entry. No prefix match, query, or
fragment.

SuggestedFix.description: A change that would make a violating post valid, offered to the client.

SuppressionDto.description: An address that is never emailed.

contact_id.description: The contact with this address, while one exists.

email.description: That contact's address, while it exists.

SuppressionReasonDto.description: Why an address is on the suppression list.

TargetGroupDto.description:

account list sees only the members inside the limit.

account_ids.description: Its member accounts the caller can see.

account_ids.description:

oneOf.description: The format the content would go out as, when one fits.

violations.description: The rules the content breaks for this account.

TestEmailRequest.description: An email to send once, as a test, to the signed-in user's own address.

TextMeasure.description: How a platform counts the length of a post.

TextRules.description: Limits on the text of a format.

includes_link_and_tags.description:
Whether the platform publishes the text, the link, and the `#tags` as one string, so
the length is measured on [`post_text`](crate::post_text). Absent means `false`.

required.description: Whether the text may not be empty.

ThroughputBucketDto.description: Attempt outcomes within one time bucket.

TrimFix.description: Trim the video to at most this many milliseconds.

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Settings the owner may change on an account.

test_account.description: Mark or unmark the account as a test account.

UpdateAiProviderDto.description: Changes a provider. Absent members keep their value.

api_key.description: Replaces the API key. Write-only: never returned.

default_model.description: New default model; added to the models when missing.

headers.description:

returned.

make_default.description: Makes it the owner's default provider. `false` changes nothing.

models.description: Replaces every configured model, by model ID.

consent_source.description: Where consent came from; cannot be blank.

fields.description: The custom merge fields, replacing the old ones.

first_name.description: A new given name, or `null` to clear it.

locale.description: A new language, or `null` to clear it.

`status_not_settable`. Subscribing a contact the owner unsubscribed is owner-only.

tags.description: The tags, replacing the old ones.

UpdatePreferences.description:
Changes the caller's preferences. Every field is optional; null or absent leaves the
stored value.

comment_digest.description: Whether comment notifications are emailed as a daily digest.

email_notifications.description: The master switch for emails about activity.

store_ai_prompts.description: Whether the caller's AI prompts are kept with their generations.

size.description: The whole file's size in bytes.

display_name.description: The user's current name, when known.
